Confirm a completed onboarding to the chapter organisers

Source: R/chapter-confirm.R
chapter_confirm_send.Rd

Sends the confirmation email from jinx@rladies.org, cc'ing chapters@rladies.org so the onboarding inbox keeps the thread, and notes on the issue that it went out.

Usage

chapter_confirm_send(
  issue_number,
  to,
  city = NULL,
  email = NULL,
  meetup_url = NULL,
  force = FALSE,
  org = "rladies",
  onboarding_repo = "new-chapters-onboarding"
)

Arguments

issue_number

Onboarding issue number.

to

Organiser email addresses.

city

Chapter city. Read from the issue when NULL.

email

Chapter email address to quote in the message.

meetup_url

Meetup URL to quote in the message.

force

Send even with checklist steps outstanding.

org

GitHub organization. Defaults to "rladies".

onboarding_repo

Repository holding onboarding issues.

Value

The sent message id (invisibly).

Details

Refuses to send while checklist steps are outstanding, since the email tells the organisers their chapter is set up. Pass force = TRUE to override, which is occasionally right - a step may be recorded elsewhere - but it should be a decision rather than an accident.

Recipient addresses are passed in rather than read from the issue: organiser emails are deliberately not stored in the issue metadata, and this function does not put them back there either. The issue comment records how many organisers were written to, not who.
